source_text: A cross-sectional study of 220 Egyptian women using the Female Sexual Function Index (FSFI) found no significant differences in overall sexual function scores between those who had undergone FGC (types I and II) and uncircumcised controls, including comparable ratings for desire, arousal, lubrication, orgasm, and satisfaction.
